title: Fix E2E harness: jsfl.spec.ts port hardcode + visual-oracle pixelmatch missing
description:
Two E2E harness bugs blocking automated testing:

1. apps/desktop/e2e/jsfl.spec.ts lines 6, 21, 35 hardcode http://localhost:5173 but the app runs on port 1420. All 3 JSFL tests fail with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. Fix: replace hardcoded URLs with baseURL from playwright config (use page.goto('/') or rely on baseURL).

2. apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts imports pixelmatch which is not installed in the desktop package. Playwright collection crashes before any test can run. Fix: add pixelmatch as a devDependency to apps/desktop/package.json (pnpm --filter @flash/desktop add -D pixelmatch) and ensure the import works.

Acceptance: pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e runs all three spec files without collection errors; smoke + jsfl tests all pass; visual-oracle tests run (may still have failures but must not crash at import).
